Commit 56a64ee04: split ddflow/adapters/mcp.py (20,559 B) into mcp.py (16,390 B: ports McpServer/McpClient + default adapters + the jsonrpc framing that is the mcp protocol home) and ddflow/adapters/_wire.py (5,678 B) — shared constants + Negotiation/Outcome/Handshake + send_line/finish_answer/_is_echo, all re-exported from mcp so fakes.mcp, surfaces/mcp_protocol and probe.py imports are unchanged. Functional smoke passed.

chunk_findings.detail: The change only splits `ddflow/adapters/mcp.py` into `_wire.py`; it does not modify `tests/test_coherence_coverage.py` (30,124 bytes) or `api/reporting/health.py` (615 lines), even though the bug record for B-main-red-size-limits lists those files as over their size limits and only `claim.py` is called out as having its own item. The listed failing `test_file_size_ratchet.py::test_no_new_oversized_file_and_no_baselined_file_grew`, `test_lifecycle_layout.py::test_no_area_module_is_a_monolith_again`, and `test_module_splits.py::test_no_area_module_is_a_monolith_again[reporting]` still exercise those untouched files, so the bug remains unfixed.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/adapters/mcp.py

chunk_findings.detail: The change deletes `_is_echo`, `finish_answer`, `send_line`, `Outcome`, `Handshake`, `Negotiation`, `negotiate`, and `describe_answer` from `ddflow/adapters/mcp.py`, but the diff adds no import of those names from the new `ddflow/adapters/_wire.py`. The retained code immediately above the deleted block still calls `_is_echo(line, frame)` and `return finish_answer(done, msg)`; when that code runs, `_is_echo` or `finish_answer` is looked up in the module globals and raises `NameError`. For example, reading a valid non-echo JSON-RPC answer reaches `finish_answer` and crashes instead of returning the parsed outcome.

chunk_findings.detail: The patch deletes the definitions of `_is_echo` and `finish_answer`, but the retained lines in the same hunk still call them: `echoed = echoed or _is_echo(line, frame)` at line 423 and `return finish_answer(done, msg)` at line 425.
